baseHeader.methodology: Source-linked original summaries and reference-guided educational reconstructions. Models and motion are unvalidated; artist titles do not independently verify taxonomy. Navigation groups are not a universal kingdom system. Microbial behavior depends on strain and conditions. Expansion entries are individually referenced authored morphology studies; legacy Protista/Monera reporting categories do not replace modern domains. Actual screenshots, software checks and draft status are distinct from independent scientific validation.

before.range: See species accounts for distribution; recorded occurrences below are not native-range boundaries.
before.summary: An irregular rough shell has unequal valves; the lower valve attaches to the substrate. It is a suspension-feeding bivalve.

anatomy.name: Rough valves
anatomy.description: Irregular rough growth surfaces: left lower cup and comparatively flat right upper valve; natural shell variation is not measured.

anatomy.name: Hinge
anatomy.description: Upper valve opens about the short retained hinge line. Ligament/adductor mechanics and internal anatomy remain absent.

anatomy.name: Mantle margin
anatomy.description: Biological reference only: mantle tissues, gills and cilia are not depicted in this external-shell reconstruction.

behaviors.label: Filtration — pending
